title: Machine Learning Engineer

nodes.title: Linear Algebra Foundations for Machine Learning
nodes.subtitle: Vectors, matrices, dot products, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, matrix decompositions (SVD)
learning_objectives: Compute matrix transformations, dot products, and vector projections in NumPy
Apply Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) for low-rank matrix approximation
feynman_prompts: How does matrix multiplication enable parallel feature transformations in machine learning?
key_misconceptions: Confusing element-wise multiplication with matrix dot products

nodes.title: Multivariate Calculus & Convex Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians, Hessians, convex functions, saddle points
learning_objectives: Compute partial derivatives and gradient vectors for multi-parameter loss functions
Analyze convergence behavior of convex optimization algorithms
feynman_prompts: Why is the gradient vector mathematically guaranteed to point in the direction of steepest ascent?
key_misconceptions: Assuming optimization functions always reach global minima in non-convex loss surfaces

nodes.title: Probability & Statistical Inference for ML
nodes.subtitle: Random variables, joint/conditional probability, Bayes theorem, Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE)
learning_objectives: Derive optimal model parameters using Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE)
Apply Bayesian inference to calculate posterior probabilities from priors
feynman_prompts: Explain how Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) finds parameters that maximize observed data probability.
key_misconceptions: Confusing prior probability with posterior probability in Bayesian decision models

nodes.title: Data Pipelines & Feature Transformations with Scikit-Learn
nodes.subtitle: Pipeline, ColumnTransformer, Standard/MinMax scalers, OneHotEncoder, custom transformers
learning_objectives: Build production-ready Scikit-Learn Pipelines that bundle pre-processing with models
Prevent data leakage by fitting transformers strictly on training splits
feynman_prompts: Why is encapsulating transformations into Scikit-Learn Pipelines essential to prevent data leakage?
key_misconceptions: Calling fit_transform() on the test split, causing test score contamination

nodes.title: Linear & Logistic Regression from Mathematical Scratch
nodes.subtitle: Cost functions (MSE, Cross-Entropy), gradient descent update rules, decision boundaries
learning_objectives: Implement linear and logistic regression from scratch in pure NumPy using vectorization
Derive gradient update formulas for Mean Squared Error and Binary Cross-Entropy losses
feynman_prompts: Why does logistic regression use the sigmoid activation function to output valid probabilities?
key_misconceptions: Using Mean Squared Error as the loss function for logistic regression instead of Cross-Entropy

nodes.title: Bias-Variance Trade-Off & Regularization Mechanics
nodes.subtitle: Underfitting, overfitting, L1 Lasso sparsity, L2 Ridge weight decay, validation learning curves
learning_objectives: Diagnose whether a model suffers from high bias or high variance using learning curves
Apply L1 and L2 regularization to constrain model complexity and prevent overfitting
feynman_prompts: Why does L1 regularization (Lasso) produce sparse weight vectors with exact zero coefficients?
key_misconceptions: Adding more training data to solve a high bias (underfitting) problem without increasing model capacity

nodes.title: Support Vector Machines & Kernel Methods
nodes.subtitle: Max-margin hyperplanes, support vectors, soft-margin slack variables (C), RBF kernel trick
learning_objectives: Train maximal margin classifiers using Support Vector Machines (SVM)
Apply non-linear kernel tricks (RBF, Polynomial) to classify non-linearly separable data
feynman_prompts: How does the Kernel Trick compute inner products in infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces without computing coordinates?
key_misconceptions: Scaling features inconsistently before training SVMs, destroying distance-based margins

nodes.title: Decision Trees & Random Forest Ensembles
nodes.subtitle: Gini impurity, information gain, tree pruning, bootstrap aggregation, out-of-bag error
learning_objectives: Construct decision trees by iteratively finding splits that maximize information gain
Train Random Forest ensembles with feature subsampling to decorrelate individual trees
feynman_prompts: How does bagging random subsets of features prevent dominant features from ruining tree diversity?
key_misconceptions: Allowing decision trees to split indefinitely until every training sample is an isolated leaf

nodes.title: Gradient Boosting & Bayesian Optimization (XGBoost)
nodes.subtitle: Boosting mechanics, negative gradients as pseudo-residuals, shrinkage, Optuna hyperparameter search
learning_objectives: Train enterprise gradient boosted decision trees using XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost
Automate Bayesian hyperparameter optimization using Optuna with tree-structured Parzen estimators
feynman_prompts: How does gradient boosting optimize arbitrary differentiable loss functions using pseudo-residuals?
key_misconceptions: Setting tree depth too high in gradient boosting, negating the regularization benefits of weak learners

nodes.title: Unsupervised Clustering & Gaussian Mixture Models
nodes.subtitle: K-Means, K-Means++, Expectation-Maximization (EM), Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), silhouette
learning_objectives: Cluster complex multi-modal data using Gaussian Mixture Models and Expectation-Maximization
Evaluate clustering quality using silhouette coefficients and Davies-Bouldin index
feynman_prompts: How does Expectation-Maximization compute soft probabilistic cluster assignments compared to hard K-Means?
key_misconceptions: Assuming clusters must always be spherical, causing K-Means to misclassify elongated groupings

nodes.title: Deep Neural Networks: Multilayer Perceptrons & Autograd
nodes.subtitle: Perceptrons, hidden layers, activation functions (ReLU, LeakyReLU, GELU), PyTorch autograd
learning_objectives: Implement multi-layer perceptrons (MLP) in PyTorch with custom forward and backward passes
Analyze vanishing and exploding gradients and resolve them using proper weight initialization (He/Xavier)
feynman_prompts: Why does the standard sigmoid activation function cause severe vanishing gradients in deep networks?
key_misconceptions: Initializing all neural network weights to zero, causing symmetric hidden neurons that never specialize

nodes.title: Deep Learning Optimization: SGD, Momentum & Adam
nodes.subtitle: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), mini-batching, Momentum, RMSprop, Adam optimizer dynamics
learning_objectives: Select optimal optimizers and tune learning rates using learning rate schedulers (Cosine Annealing)
Explain how Adam combines momentum with adaptive per-parameter learning rate scaling
feynman_prompts: How does momentum help gradient descent escape shallow local minima and navigate saddle points?
key_misconceptions: Using default constant learning rates without warmups or decay schedules on complex architectures

nodes.title: Regularization: Dropout, Batch Normalization & LayerNorm
nodes.subtitle: Dropout mechanics, Batch Normalization, Layer Normalization, Weight Decay, data augmentation
learning_objectives: Stabilize deep neural network training using Batch Normalization and Layer Normalization
Prevent overfitting in large neural networks using Dropout and stochastic regularizations
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between Batch Normalization (across batch) and Layer Normalization (across features)?
key_misconceptions: Leaving Dropout active during model inference, producing noisy non-deterministic predictions

nodes.title: Computer Vision: CNNs & Residual Architectures
nodes.subtitle: Convolution operations, receptive fields, stride/padding, ResNet skip connections, transfer learning
learning_objectives: Implement convolutional neural networks for image classification and feature extraction
Fine-tune pre-trained vision backbones with frozen layers and progressive unfreezing
feynman_prompts: Why do residual skip connections allow training neural networks with 100+ layers without gradient vanishing?
key_misconceptions: Unfreezing all pre-trained backbone weights immediately with a high learning rate, destroying pre-trained representations

nodes.title: Self-Attention Mechanisms & The Transformer Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, queries/keys/values, positional encodings
learning_objectives: Implement multi-head self-attention mechanisms in PyTorch from mathematical primitives
Explain how self-attention captures long-range token dependencies in parallel compared to sequential RNNs
feynman_prompts: Why is the attention matrix calculation QK^T / sqrt(d_k) scaled by the square root of key dimension?
key_misconceptions: Thinking self-attention has innate knowledge of word order without adding positional encodings

nodes.title: Model Optimization: Quantization & ONNX Runtime
nodes.subtitle: Post-training quantization (PTQ), FP16 vs INT8, model pruning, ONNX export, TensorRT acceleration
learning_objectives: Quantize PyTorch neural networks to INT8, reducing memory footprint by 75% with < 1% accuracy drop
Export models to ONNX format and run high-performance inference using ONNX Runtime
feynman_prompts: How does INT8 quantization achieve 3x inference acceleration on modern CPU/GPU hardware?
key_misconceptions: Deploying raw un-optimized PyTorch models directly in latency-sensitive production environments

nodes.title: Comprehensive Model Evaluation & Error Analysis
nodes.subtitle: Confusion matrix, F1-score, Brier score calibration, Cohen's kappa, error slicing, slicing metrics
learning_objectives: Calibrate model probabilities using Platt scaling or isotonic regression to reflect true likelihoods
Conduct granular error analysis across underrepresented demographic or technical slices
feynman_prompts: Why is a model with 95% accuracy useless if its predicted probabilities are completely uncalibrated?
key_misconceptions: Evaluating models only on aggregate top-line metrics, hiding catastrophic failure on key minority slices

nodes.title: Production ML Deployment & Low-Latency Serving
nodes.subtitle: TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, FastAPI, dynamic batching, model caching, health checks
learning_objectives: Deploy containerized machine learning models behind low-latency FastAPI / Triton inference endpoints
Configure dynamic batching to maximize GPU throughput under concurrent prediction requests
feynman_prompts: Why is dynamic request batching essential for high-throughput GPU model serving?
key_misconceptions: Running model inference synchronously inside the web framework event loop without worker isolation

description: Master Machine Learning Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
